answer.text: Taking long positions in undervalued stocks and short positions in overvalued stocks

explanation.text: The Logic: Long/Short Equity takes long positions in attractively valued stocks and short positions in overvalued stocks to generate alpha with reduced market risk. The Trap: Long-only or short-only don't capture the strategy. Cross-Exam Context: Common Cat III AIF strategy. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Evaluate the net long/short exposure to understand market-sensitivity.
